memories.author: D03
memories.text: Reason for visit: crampy abdominal pain and bloating for 2 months. PRESENTING COMPLAINT: She reports pain in lower abdomen, worsens after meals, associated with loose stools up to 3 times/day, no blood or weight loss. EXAMINATION: BP 118/76 mmHg, weight 58 kg, height 158 cm, BMI 23.2 (overweight). Abdomen soft, mild tenderness in left iliac fossa, no guarding. IMPRESSION: Irritable bowel syndrome, likely diarrhoea-predominant. ARRANGEMENTS: Start mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD, loperamide 2 mg SOS. Order CBC, stool routine, tTG-IgA for coeliac screen. Return if fever >39°C, vomiting, severe pain, blood in stool, or weight loss.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Reason for visit: follow-up of IBS, symptoms improved. PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Reports abdominal discomfort only after spicy meals, bowel movements 1-2 formed per day, no urgency. EXAMINATION: BP 120/78 mmHg, weight 59 kg, BMI 23.6 (overweight). Abdomen non-tender. IMPRESSION: IBS, diarrhoea-predominant, partially controlled. ARRANGEMENTS: Continue mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD, loperamide 2 mg SOS as needed. Repeat CBC in 3 months. Return if worsening pain, bleeding, fever >39°C, or weight loss.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Noticed increased bloating after eating raw cabbage and cauliflower at market; pain mild, no diarrhoea. Wondering if I should avoid these vegetables.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Reason for visit: bloating after certain vegetables. PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Bloating and mild distension after raw cruciferous vegetables, otherwise well, bowel habits normal. EXAMINATION: BP 119/77 mmHg, weight 60 kg, BMI 24.0 (overweight). Abdomen soft, no tenderness. IMPRESSION: IBS with food-triggered bloating; likely fermentable carbohydrates. ARRANGEMENTS: Advise low-FODMAP trial, reduce raw cabbage/cauliflower, cooked vegetables tolerated. Increase ispaghula husk to 10 g OD for bulk. Continue mebeverine 135 mg BD, loperamide 2 mg SOS. Repeat stool routine. Return if severe pain, vomiting, fever >39°C, or bleeding.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Reason for visit: routine IBS review. PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Reports good control, occasional bloating after lentils, bowel movements 1-2 formed per day, no urgency. EXAMINATION: BP 122/80 mmHg, weight 61 kg, BMI 24.4 (overweight). Abdomen non-tender. IMPRESSION: IBS stable on current regimen. ARRANGEMENTS: Continue mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 10 g OD, loperamide 2 mg SOS. Advise maintain low-FODMAP as tolerated, regular exercise. Return if new alarm symptoms: weight loss, bleeding, fever >39°C, severe pain.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Reason for visit: final check before festival season. PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Feels well, mild bloating after festive sweets, otherwise normal bowel pattern. EXAMINATION: BP 121/79 mmHg, weight 62 kg, BMI 24.8 (overweight). Abdomen soft. IMPRESSION: IBS under control. ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current meds, consider probiotic if symptoms worsen. Return if alarm symptoms develop.
